title: Origami Flow: First-time briefs and contextual anchors for cost & rollout workspaces
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Problem: New users landing in Console are overwhelmed by dense dashboards and unfamiliar rollout terminology. We need a lightweight, progressively-disclosed onboarding surface that orients users to cost cards, rollout controls, and the tracing/rollout lifecycle without blocking workflows.

Goal: Design a non-modal, persistent 'Origami Flow' that surfaces three contextual affordances: 1) First-time brief cards describing the primary workspace actions, 2) anchored chevrons (contextual anchors) that reveal inline microtips, and 3) a lightweight setup checklist template that can be completed or snoozed. The experience should be dismissible, configurable, and instrumentable so PM/Analytics can measure activation and conversion metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype demonstrates first-time brief cards for Cost, Rollouts, and Routes with copy variations A/B ready
Anchored chevron pattern implemented in Figma components and mapped to Console DOM anchors (card, rollout row, cost breakdown)
Design tokens and motion specs provided for engineering handoff (timing, easing, z-index rules)
Event list for instrumentation (tooltip_shown, brief_dismissed, checklist_completed) documented
Accessibility audit notes included (keyboard dismissible, screen reader labels)
Handoff package uploaded to Drive with copy spreadsheet, Figma prototype, and QA checklist
tasks: Create low-fidelity flows for three entry patterns: (a) Fresh workspace, (b) Returning user with new features, (c) Admin onboarding
Design and iterate microcopy for brief cards with PM and Research (3 variations)
Build anchored chevron component in Figma and document responsive behavior
Run 5 moderated usability sessions focusing on discoverability and non-interruptiveness
Consolidate final prototype and export design tokens for engineering
Prepare instrumentation spec and work with Analytics to define success metrics

decisions: Use anchored chevrons instead of banners to minimize visual noise
Persist brief/checklist state per workspace in user metadata to improve completion continuity
Expose 'Snooze for 7 days' and 'Don't show again' in brief actions to reduce frustration
A/B test copy length: short (1 line + CTA) vs short + 2 line contextual sentence
Roll out to new workspaces first, then staged rollout to 25% of returning users behind feature flag
notes_for_engineering: Provide a single small API to persist onboarding hint state per workspace
Expose hook for tooltip positioning tied to element ids; fallback to smart-edge placement
Bundle lightweight CSS for chevron animation; avoid layout shift on load
qa_notes: Verify anchors remain correct when panels collapse/expand
Confirm keyboard accessibility and SR labels for each brief
Test snooze/dismiss persistence across sessions and devices
